data.description:
## Knowledge Needed
- Read: docs/design-git-training-data-structures.md (Streaming section)
- Understand: Python generators and memory management
- Review: git log pagination options

## Implementation
1. Generator-based commit streaming
2. Batch processing with configurable batch size
3. Memory-bounded processing (never load all commits)
4. Progress reporting during streaming

## Guardrails
- DO: Use generators throughout the pipeline
- DO: Support --batch-size CLI option
- DO: Report memory usage during training
- DO NOT: Break non-streaming path (keep both options)
- DO NOT: Over-complicate for small repos
- EXPLORE: Async/parallel commit fetching
- EXPLORE: Resumable training (checkpoint support)

## Success Criteria
- Can train on repos with 100K+ commits
- Memory usage stays bounded
- Training speed comparable to batch approach
- Works with existing deduplication
data.title: Streaming iterator pattern for memory-efficient training
